units.source_text: ……我完全沉洒在幻影的金阁怀抱里，并不是很长的时间。

en.t: ... I was completely sunk in the embrace of the phantom Golden Pavilion, but not for very long.

units.source_text: 待我清醒过来时，金阁已经隐没了。

en.t: When I came back to myself, the Golden Pavilion had already vanished.

units.source_text: 其实它只不过是一座如今依然存在的建筑物而且。

en.t: In truth, it was nothing more than a building that still exists today.

units.source_text: 它耸立在东北方向的遥远的衣笠山麓，从这里是不可能看见的。

en.t: It stood far away to the northeast, at the foot of Mount Kinugasa, and from here it could not possibly be seen.

units.source_text: 那样接受我、拥抱我的金阁幻影的时间，已经消逝了。

en.t: The time of that phantom Golden Pavilion, which had received me and embraced me like that, had already passed away.

units.source_text: 我躺在龟山公园的山冈顶上，四周只有草花和慢慢飞翔的昆虫，以及一个放肆地横躺着的姑娘。

en.t: I lay on the top of the hill in Kameyama Park, with nothing around me but grasses and flowers, insects flying slowly, and a girl sprawled there without restraint.
